      How customer reviews and ratings work

      Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

      To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

      Top reviews from Australia

      • Jason
        5 out of 5 stars
        Excellent Headphones; Expensive, But Great if you Love Apple
        Reviewed in Australia on 11 March 2022
        Colour: Sky Blue
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Bought these to replace a pair of 6 year old Bose QC35's. They are still going, but the battery is just starting to lose their charge on those.

        I wanted to stay in the Apple ecosystem as I already own the AirPod Pros; love the super easy connection to Apple devices. The switching between devices is very good which is what I wanted.

        They are high quality build as you would expect from Apple. The noice cancellation is as good as you would expect from wireless headphones of this calibre. Just as good as the QC35's; cannot compare to Sony's headphones which I hear are amazing as well.

        I tend to keep these charged quite often so I cannot speak to the length of a charge. I dont use these very heavily; mostly late at night for a few hours watching TV, listening to music on my Mac when others have gone to bed, a bit more on the weekend. Maybe about a week or so using these that much. With heavy daily use it would be much more often obviously.

        So, the price of these; even Amazon selling for a bit of a cheaper price puts these at a high entry price. I would argue the QC35's are probably better value for money if you are getting a first pair of quality wireless headphones.

        At the price these go for, its purely for the the Apple aesthetic, the connection to other Apple devices across an eco-system. They really feel more like a guilty pleasure purchase for sure; the sound from the QC35's I have were just as good in many ways. I am not an audiophile by any stretch though, I just know they both sound good.

        Also the QC35's did not seem as tight to wear and the cushioning on the cups on those were just like a pillow. You could forget you were wearing those, AirPods Max are definitely heavier and a bit tighter fit, but still quite comfortable even for hours of use.

        Most novice headphone fans will likely get better value with other cheaper cans. If you like the look of these specifically, if you LOVE Apple products, are deep in their ecosystem and have multiple Apple devices that you switch between, then these might be worth the extra cost. They look and sound amazing and I am loving them a lot.

      • Troy
        5 out of 5 stars
        Exceptional Sound Quality and Comfort – Worth Every Penny!
        Reviewed in Australia on 11 July 2024
        Colour: Sky Blue
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I recently purchased the Apple AirPods Max in Sky Blue, and I couldn't be more impressed with these headphones. They are truly a game-changer in terms of sound quality, comfort, and overall experience.

        The sound quality is phenomenal. The audio is incredibly crisp and clear, with deep, rich bass and detailed highs. The spatial audio feature adds an immersive experience, making you feel like you're in the middle of the action. I've listened to music, watched movies and took calls and the sound performance has been consistently outstanding.

        The noise cancellation is top-notch. It effectively blocks out background noise when I'm on the train, allowing me to fully immerse myself in whatever I'm listening to. The transparency mode is also fantastic, letting me stay aware of my surroundings without taking off the headphones so I don't miss my stop.

        Comfort is another area where the AirPods Max excel. I was a little worried if they were going to be too heavy but the memory foam ear cushions are incredibly soft and conform to my ears perfectly, making them comfortable to wear for extended periods. The headband took a little getting used to but the distributed weight seems to prevent any discomfort or pressure on my head.

        The build quality is exactly what you would expect from Apple – premium and durable. The Sky Blue color is stunning and adds a touch of elegance to the overall design. The integration with Apple devices is seamless. Pairing the AirPods Max with my iPhone, iPad, and MacBook was effortless, and the switching between devices is smooth and instantaneous. The controls are intuitive and easy to use, and Siri integration is a convenient feature.

        Battery life is impressive as well. I can use the AirPods Max for hours on end without needing to recharge, and the smart case helps preserve battery life when they're not in use.

        Overall, the Apple AirPods Max in Sky Blue are an exceptional investment. The sound quality, comfort, and premium build make them worth every penny. If you're looking for high-end headphones that deliver an unparalleled audio experience, these are the ones to get. Highly recommended!

        5 out of 5 stars
        Best headphones ever!
        Reviewed in Australia on 24 December 2021
        Colour: Space Grey
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

        I have been using these headphones for about 2 months now. I never expected these headphones to be this good. And yet they are. Battery lasts long and seamlessly switches between different Apple devices.

        Music is insanely good. Computational audio is not just a gimmick, it truly does work. I've never heard such rich and big bodied bass in any headphones ever. And with 0 distortion no matter how loud you listen. Some house music makes my ears vibrate, what a glorious feeling.

        Movies are another pleasure to watch with. I kept taking the headphones off when I first started using them because I thought someone was in the house. I even answered the door once thinking someone was knocking on the door. That's how spacious the sound stage is.

        Noise cancellation is perfect. Both buttons are very high quality and easy to use.

        As for any downsides, the case is an absolute joke. They should fire the hipster idiot who came up with that stupid design and fire the manager who gave the go ahead. Absolutely useless. Only use is to save battery coz' it drains the battery if it's not in the case albeit takes a while but still drains. However it doesn't put me off from the listening experience.

        If you can afford it, don't think twice about it. Having listened to planar magnetic and $$$ headphones before, nothing even comes close without an amp.

      • Mustard
        4 out of 5 stars
        A premium, but expensive audio experience.
        Reviewed in Australia on 3 November 2023
        Colour: Space Grey
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Design: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

        When I first donned the AirPods Max, I found them slightly uncomfortable, initially feeling heavy and imposing. The weight and the pressure points were noticeable. However, as I continued to use them over days, it became apparent that these headphones adapt to your head. The memory foam ear cushions seemed to adjust, and I started to experience a level of comfort I hadn't anticipated. The premium materials and minimalist design remained stunning, and the build quality was undeniable.

        Audio Quality: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

        The AirPods Max offer a neutral sound profile that's music to anyone's ears. Instrument separation is exceptional, and the crisp highs are a treat for those who enjoy well-defined audio. Personally, I'm a bass lover, and out of the box, the AirPods Max may seem to lack a bit in the bass department. However, Spotify's customisable EQ settings allow you to fine-tune the audio to your preference. With a little adjustment, these headphones are more than capable of delivering a punchy bass while maintaining crystal-clear highs and mids, making them versatile for various music genres.

        Connectivity: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)

        Connectivity remains one of the AirPods Max's standout features. Seamlessly integrating into the Apple ecosystem, these headphones pair effortlessly with iOS devices. The automatic switching function, as well as the spatial audio feature, are perfect for those immersed in the Apple ecosystem. It's a connectivity experience that truly complements Apple's user-friendly approach.

        Battery Life: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ (4/5)

        The advertised 20 hours of battery life may seem ambitious, but my personal experience has been that the AirPods Max deliver around the same or even better performance. Quick charging, with 1.5 hours of playback in just 5 minutes, is a handy feature for those on the go.

        Price: ⭐⭐⭐ (3/5)

        While the AirPods Max offer an outstanding audio experience, their price tag remains a significant deterrent. I only decided to purchase them because of a special deal. It's important to note that these headphones do not come with an audio cable, which is quite surprising given the premium price point. To connect via cable, you'll need to buy an Apple-branded "bi-directional" audio cable, as third-party options won't work. This adds to the overall cost, making these headphones an even more exclusive investment.

        The AirPods Max, getting comfier by the day, blasting out incredible audio, and connecting seamlessly, show that Apple's all about quality. While they come with a premium price tag and some additional costs for essential accessories, they deliver an audio experience that will satisfy even the most discerning listeners. If you can catch them at a special price and invest in the necessary accessories, the AirPods Max can be a valuable addition to your audio arsenal.

        Comfortable, easy charging with the lightning cable.

        Pairs easily within the Apple Work Environment, eg, iphone, macbook, ipad etc. Works brilliantly with other bluetooth devices as well, like the Samsung TV.

        Overall a great headphone.
